clean_room: Only public APIs/signatures/enums,public fields,builtins and opaque pinned module hashes/CRLF-to-LF proofs. No reference implementation,bytecode or private state inspected.

failed_build_repair.cause: The general attribute hashability helper includes wrapper/detail metadata; backwards scalar replay explicitly treats that detail as the original scalar string.
failed_build_repair.correction: Reject genuinely non-scalar unhashable activities while preserving the existing resolved scalar-string/null replay semantics. Public list/dict controls and exact prior return projections remain required.
failed_build_repair.failure: Two of six focused tests failed: diagnostics terminated with0xc0000409; event_data rejected retained scalar XES detail as an unhashable activity.

progress.criteria: All complete successful native JSON rows and non-error metadata are compared exactly, preserving prior raw trace/wire/full PLTR projections. Strict original exception projection criteria remain unchanged. New separate family criteria map descriptive native missing-key errors to the selected key, generic unhashable errors to a container-unspecified family, and the established zero-token-fitness domain error. Native C++ exception classes/messages/argument carriers are not Python exception parity. List/dict specificity, exact class/message/args, public backwards transition mutations, allocation behavior and broader models remain open.
